# Windows installation/upgrade guidance for development builds

**v0.6 release note:** the historical v0.5.0 installer is a confirmed previous build, not v0.6. A Windows installer for the current v0.6 commit must first be generated by the Windows CI workflow.

On a real Windows test VM: back up user data with Settings → Download SQLite backup; record the SHA-256 of the installer from CI; install using the `.exe` NSIS artifact and launch normally; configure cloud consent/key only if desired (local Ollama is default); confirm settings, sessions, drafts and transcripts; close the process and inspect Task Manager for child worker cleanup; reopen; perform v0.5→v0.6 upgrade, verify SQLite `PRAGMA user_version=6` and data preservation; uninstall and reinstall; verify persisted user data according to agreed retention policy. Perform upgrade tests with data copies, never sole original user data.

Windows Credential Manager keys are scoped to the Windows user and are not exported with the SQLite backup. To remove a key use Settings → Delete stored key. No bundled model weights are included. Real audio, webcam, microphone, Docker and network conditions must be tested on user-owned supported devices, with consent.

Evidence needed: Windows CI run ID, installer/portable SHA-256, `cargo test`, TypeScript production build, Python tests including OS vault integration, clean installation, installed app/worker startup, upgraded DB integrity, uninstall/reinstall smoke and user-data retention.
